snippet.title: SNES Cyber Knight
snippet.description:
How much I love this game! Developed by Group SNE and published by Tonkin House  in Japan, 1992's "Cyber Knight" (itself a port from 1990's PC Engine game of the same name) is a rather novel concept from the usual medieval fantasy RPGs. This sci-fi tactical RPG reminds me of "Phantasy Star", "Buck Rogers" (the Megadrive video game),"Star Trek" and "Starship Troopers" (the anime adaptation) mixed into a very neat package. Thanks to legendary hacker Gideon Zhi of AGTP, this game was fully translated into English back in 2001, making it accessible to the west. It was fantastic to be able to fully comprehended a game I only had know from still pictures on foreign video game magazines. An impressive sequel that caries the plot onwards from this game was release two years later. Enjoy some early plot gameplay!

Romhacking.net project page: http://www.romhacking.net/translations/304/
